P3.window: first 60 s of events; frames whose shifted window [tau, tau + 33.333 ms) lies inside it

P4.definition: tracks living at least 1 s; vehicles = class_id in {1,3,4,5,6}; speed = median over the track's evaluation instants of |velocity over the last 100 ms|; area = median w*h over frames

P5.command: python3 -m pytest -p no:anyio (system pytest 6.2.5; '-p no:anyio' disables a user-site anyio plugin that is incompatible with that pytest and aborts collection)
P5.earlier_run: commit bd49a3a, same command: exit 0, no skips

cost.note: cost per instant is wall time on one core of cnt for all six settings and three models
cost.sample: 15 evenly spaced instants of each of 16 recordings (every 7th in sorted order), 16 workers
